text:
elena: Quick heads-up: planning a compact access recert and ownerless-key sweep next week. Goal: reduce attack surface without impacting running infra. Need volunteers for key ownership verification and CI pipeline checks.
tom: I can take CI pipelines. Ill grep for KMS aliases in our repos and CI configs.
sec-bot: initial scan: 17 keys with missing owner metadata; 5 keys have aliases that do not match any service. Report: /audit/reports/4125006789-ownerless-keys.csv
ops-runner: nice. Reminder: some keys are used by backup/restore jobs that run monthly. Those can look idle for 30d+ but are still required.
elena: plan is to split into two streams: 1) ownerproof (email+tag) for low-risk keys, 2) manual review for keys tied to infra groups or with unusual grant patterns.
infra-bot: sample query for locating aliases in infra state: ```bash\ngrep -R "kms_alias" infra/ | sed -n '1,200p'\n```
sec-bot: unusual grant pattern flagged: key arn:aws:kms:...:legacy-db-backup has cross-account grants dating back 400d. Marked for manual triage.
mike-sre: if cross-account grants are in place, we should coordinate with partner teams before any change. Also, any key used by the snapshotter needs a preserved ACL.
tom: found a handful of QName references in our old terraform modules. I'll open PRs to centralize alias references and add comments.
elena: timeline proposal: Monday staging dry-run (mark/tag only), Wed morning start manual reviews, Fri AM small removals (staging succeeded) — production removals next Tue in the 02:00-05:00 UTC window.
ops-runner: sounds good. Can we add a `pending-owner-verification` tag instead of immediate deletion? That gives owners time to respond.
sec-bot: tagging supported. Applying tag creates audit entry: /audit/logs/4125006789/tags.log
mike-sre: monitoring note: add a short-lived alert on `kms_api:Decrypt` error spikes and `job:backup_failure` during rollout. I'll add runbook instructions for fast rollback.
elena: rollback method: reinstate grants from snapshot and remove tag. We'll keep a TTLed snapshot in S3: `s3://redwood-prune-snapshots/4125006789.json`.
tom: for ownerproof well send an automated email and Slack ping via `recert-bot` with a 72-hour ack window. If acked, we clear the flag. If not, move to manual review.
sec-bot: recert-bot integration ready. Example command: `recert-bot send --list=ownerless-4125 --ack-window=72h`
ops-runner: vulnerability note: a recent vuln triage flagged privilege escalation risk in our legacy keyring tooling. We should include those keys in manual review and escalate if any privileged account has stale access.
mike-sre: good catch. Which vuln ID?
sec-bot: vuln tracker: VT-2025-88 - legacy-keyring tooling allows long-lived grants if not pruned. See internal vuln link: https://redwood.internal/vuln/VT-2025-88
elena: include VT-2025-88 mitigation steps in the manual review checklist.
tom: volunteers for manual triage tomorrow? I can do a pass from 10-13 UTC.
ops-runner: I can cover 13-16 UTC and focus on backups + cross-account.
mike-sre: I'll handle monitoring/playbooks and coordinate rollback hooks.
sec-bot: automated pre-checks to run before any removal: 1) recent use in logs (120d), 2) terraform/helm reference check, 3) CI reference check, 4) cross-account grants flag. Script: ```sql\nSELECT key_id, last_kms_call, referenced_in_repo FROM kms_audit WHERE last_kms_call > now() - interval '120 days';\n```
elena: please run the pre-checks and post CSVs to /audit/reports/4125006789/ before Monday.
tom: will do. Posting initial repo grep in thread when ready.
ops-runner: ops note: bump audit retention to 180 days for this wave. We'll revert after 30 days.
sec-bot: audit retention updated request acknowledged. Changelog entry queued: CHG-4125006789.
elena: final: we'll run a short tabletop at 01:30 UTC on prod-removal day and maintain this thread as the coordination channel. Call pager if any automated alerts fire.
mike-sre: ack.
sec-bot: scan summary: /audit/logs/4125006789/summary.txt
elena: thanks all. Action items: tom = repo/CI grep + PRs, ops-runner = backup crosscheck + tagging, mike-sre = alerts + runbook, sec-bot = send recert pings and post reports.
